soft_findings_not_disagreements.impact: uniform across all 19 lore rows, so it is a single parent-level policy call, not 19 per-seat calls. Verdicts above use the PROVINCE 'touching it' reading (which is what makes them SAFE); under the strict AGENTS.md reading they would all be NOT-SAFE(owning-lane-unpushed).
soft_findings_not_disagreements.recommendation: resolve once toward PROVINCE: the registration is detached metadata and its tip (28706dc / 2b48ca7) is fully contained in refs/heads/main and refs/remotes/origin/main, so no unique object is at risk from the metadata prune.
